thread:
jas (sec-eng): Heads-up: new tenant `beta-co` failing SCIM provisioning after SAML onboarding. Users appear in IdP but SCIM PATCH -> 403 from our side. No auth errors, just provisioning.
lee (idp-platform): Can you drop the exact error snippet? 403 usually indicates permission or decryption problem.
jas (sec-eng): From provisioner logs (sanitized):
```
2026-02-04T09:12:11Z ERROR provisioner: scim PATCH user/abc -> 403 {"error":"forbidden: decrypt extid failed: InvalidCiphertextException"}
2026-02-04T09:12:11Z DEBUG provisioner: stored_ciphertext: eyJhbGciOiJ...
2026-02-04T09:12:11Z WARN  role-mapper: mapping miss for extId acct:beta-co:devs
```
lee (idp-platform): InvalidCiphertextException = KMS refuses to decrypt, often context mismatch or different key/alias. Did Beta-Co recently change their metadata or did our canonicalization change?
tori (infra): Our KMS logs show rejects for that tenant around 09:10Z with encryption-context mismatch. We log the attempted context on rejects.
jas (sec-eng): I pulled one ciphertext and tried local decrypt with staging KMS key and current context: `extId=acct:beta-co:devs,meta_v=2` -> fails. Trying with `meta_v=1` succeeds.
lee (idp-platform): That suggests some payloads were encrypted under older metadata_version. Why would meta_v differ? Check onboarder version history. We rolled a metadata normalization change last week that switched canonicalization rules.
jas (sec-eng): Onboarder v3.7 normalized attribute ordering which bumped `meta_v`. A mix of producers (some older queued jobs) could have used meta_v=1. KMS decryption will fail if the encryption context doesn't match exactly.
lee (idp-platform): Right. We need decrypt-compatibility: attempt decrypt with current context first, then with previous contexts. Also log which context succeeded so we can backfill.
al (prod-sec): Also: fallback policy for RBAC important. Currently provisioner aborts on decrypt error and user creation fails. For compliance we need audit trail and a least-privileged fallback role. Propose: create account with `role:viewer` and mark a flag `scim.encrypted_extid_unverified=true`. Emit audit event.
scooter-bot: alert: deploy request created deploy-2026-02-04-probe-fallback (PR #4302) by tori
tori (infra): I'll cut a canary that enables probe-mode for tenant=beta-co only. Small change: catch decrypt exceptions, try alternate contexts, fallback to viewer role and emit metric `scim.provision.fallback=1` with tag `tenant:beta-co`.
jas (sec-eng): Also need to add a check in onboarding that trims/normalizes XML attribute whitespace. Beta-co metadata had attribute formatting like `xmlns =` and some vendors include non-breaking spaces. Our XML canonicalizer became stricter in v3.7. Add tests that reserialize with permissive parser.
lee (idp-platform): Agreed. We'll add a normalization pass that collapses whitespace on attribute tokens and runs exclusive canonicalization (C14N) before building extId. That should reduce churn across meta_v bumps.
al (prod-sec): For the incident record: create ticket INC-2026-0014 severity=P2 (provisioning interruption). Include auditor logs and list of affected tenants (so far beta-co). Don't rotate KMS keys yet; we need compatibility path first.
jas (sec-eng): I've created INC-2026-0014 and linked logs + ciphertext samples. Starting a 30m bridge to coordinate.
tori (infra): Quick command for local repro for anyone on the bridge (use staging creds):
```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://cipher.bin --key-id alias/rdw-provisioner --encryption-context "extId=acct:beta-co:devs,meta_v=1"
```
If meta_v=1 returns plaintext, run the same with meta_v=2 to confirm mismatch.
lee (idp-platform): Also check whether any prior onboarding runs used alternate KMS alias (we rotated alias last quarter). Try decrypt with `alias/rdw-provisioner-old`.
jas (sec-eng): Confirmed some ciphertexts decrypt only with old alias. There was a small window during key alias swap where queued jobs used the old alias. We should add decryption fallback to try both aliases in order: current alias -> prev alias -> fail.
al (prod-sec): Good. Add audit log entry whenever we use fallback alias or context so we can quantify incidence. That helps compliance reviews.
tori (infra): I'll land the canary now (PR #4302) and run for 15 minutes, monitor metrics and rollback if error rate spikes.

jas (sec-eng): Postmortem action items: 1) add compatibility decrypt path (try current+previous contexts + aliases) 2) add XML attribute whitespace normalization tests in onboarder integration suite 3) change default fallback role to `viewer` with audited flag 4) ensure incidents for any future meta_v bump are auto-notified to sec-eng and idp-platform.
lee (idp-platform): I'll take 1 and 2. tori, take 3 and 4 with infra/product-security.
jas (sec-eng): Thanks team. We'll update INC-2026-0014 with bridge notes and ETA for full rollback. :thumbsup:
